entities.name: CoaBC bifunctional enzyme
observations: The 404-aa query has 47.4% identity and 94.8% coverage to reviewed Bacillus subtilis CoaBC (UniProt O35033; E-value 2.02e-106).
Homolog annotations assign phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase activity (EC 6.3.2.5) and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity (EC 4.1.1.36) in coenzyme A biosynthesis.
Homologs are annotated with FMN and Mg2+ cofactors; this is reference-protein evidence, not direct measurement of the query.
Sequence is 404 aa; predicted mass 44,780 Da and theoretical pI 6.32.
Pfam hits: Flavoprotein PF02441 at residues 2–177 and DFP PF04127 at residues 183–389.
